sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This sole Test-owned virtual executor is always shutdownNow in finally and awaitTermination10 is asserted while allFuture waits retain5seconds. It intentionally avoids unbounded implicitclose perBUG2753; no shared or application resource exists.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: These exact create/submit/shutdown/await sites are the closedJUnit64independent immutable-value concurrency test, not JakartaEE unmanaged work. The same single executor and finiteFuture5/finallyawait10 bound the whole owner; no external operation is performed.

sourceAnchors.message: A throw statement in a finally block makes the control flow hard to understand.
sourceAnchors.reason: This Test-only finally throws AssertionError precisely if its own worker resource fails to terminate within10seconds; otherwise the original assertions and exceptions remain unchanged. A failed resource postcondition must fail the test, never become business success.
